en-US.author: Jens Roggenfelder
en-US.description: Cloud-free revival for Bose SoundTouch speakers. Unofficial community project, not affiliated with Bose.
en-US.longDescription:
ST Reborn (STR) brings internet radio, Spotify Connect, the hardware preset keys and multiroom back to Bose SoundTouch speakers after the Bose cloud shutdown. The desktop app installs a small agent onto the speaker over your home network and then controls every speaker running STR, with no Bose cloud and no account.
STR is an independent open source project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Bose Corporation. Bose and SoundTouch are registered trademarks of Bose Corporation.

en-US.releaseNotes:
STR v1.5.3
Built from commit: 3efd1945723a14ef158e0424c31d489ce80ec9ba
Workflow run: https://github.com/JRpersonal/streborn/actions/runs/42113389452

What's changed in v1.5.3

Fixes
- A speaker whose Bose firmware has not started keeps its name and place in the app instead of showing up as a new speaker (agent)
- Renaming a stereo pair now also renames the speaker's own Spotify entry, so the Spotify app shows the new " (L+R)" instead of the old pair name (multiroom)
- The language picker on the phone now carries a "Language" label (remote)
- The mute button on the phone now uses the speaker's own mute, so it shows the same state as the app and the speaker's remote (remote)

Verify your download
Every binary in this release is attested by GitHub's build provenance system.
# SHA256 checksum
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
# Sigstore attestation (requires GitHub CLI)
gh attestation verify STR-Windows.exe --owner JRpersonal

Code signing
Windows: signed with a Certum Open Source code signing certificate. SmartScreen may still warn while the signature builds download reputation.
macOS: signed with a Developer ID certificate and notarized by Apple. The app and the disk image each carry a stapled ticket, so Gatekeeper opens them without a warning, offline included.
Any warning you do see, and the exact click path past it, is documented on the website Verify page.
